artifact_set.magic_constant_policy: FORBID hard-coded 30 in release logic; derive from package set and control set
rules: exactly one wheel and one sdist per first-party publishable package unless a package-specific platform matrix is explicitly introduced
every release asset is represented in payload-manifest.json and SHA256SUMS
payload-manifest.json binds source commit, source tree, release identity, package-set digest, workflow run ID/attempt, and every member asset digest
candidate container identity (Actions artifact ID and artifact SHA-256 digest) is recorded only after upload in a separate preflight-receipt.json; it MUST NOT be embedded into the artifact it hashes
preflight receipt binds candidate artifact ID/digest to payload-manifest SHA-256 plus source/release/run identities
release-lock binds package identities, normalized project names, versions, wheel hashes, sdist semantic-content hashes and dependency graph
SBOM coverage must include all publishable first-party projects and exact versions
release publisher must reject missing, unexpected, mismatched, or digest-unknown assets
conformance-bundle.zip binds the exact tests/, tools/ and conformance/ source snapshot used by the candidate

attestation.github_sbom_attestation: required for wheels against release SBOM where supported
attestation.pypi_pep740: required for each wheel/sdist published through Trusted Publisher
attestation.slsa_claim: TARGET_BUILD_L2_EVIDENCE_ONLY; L3 prohibited without builder-isolation assessment

build.fresh_install: every wheel and sdist-derived wheel must install in clean environments
build.network_policy: dependency acquisition may use network before frozen build environment; release candidate build should consume pinned admitted toolchain/dependencies; hermeticity is a future explicit target, not claimed
build.resolver_test: construct local offline wheelhouse/simple-index over exact candidate set; host and plugins must resolve without PyPI
build.sdist_reproducibility: semantic-content equivalence required; raw byte identity preferred but not required until backend is demonstrated deterministic
build.source_date_epoch: derive from admitted git source commit timestamp; fail if invalid; propagate to child builds

claim_ceiling: no production readiness, SLSA L3, independent security certification, exhaustive correctness, or external adapter conformance without separate evidence

irreversibility.github: after immutable release publication assets/tag are immutable; prepublication must use draft exact-set reconciliation
irreversibility.pypi: files are uploaded one at a time across multiple projects; do not depend on upload order; partial publication is explicit and reconciled, never represented as atomic rollback
irreversibility.recovery: wrong published PyPI artifact/version requires BLOCK + incident procedure; prefer yanking over destructive deletion when appropriate

import_name_metadata_policy.reason: do not infer import metadata solely from distribution names; verify package contents and emitted core metadata
import_name_metadata_policy.standard: PEP 794 / current pyproject import-names and import-namespaces

package_set.source: R9 live repository package metadata admitted as migration evidence
package_set.version_policy: single coordinated pre-release version across all first-party packages unless future ADR explicitly allows independent versioning

publication_order: PyPI precheck and Trusted Publisher authorization
PyPI missing-only exact publication with partial-state reconciliation

decision_rule.forbidden: silently reuse historical identity after a material contract rewrite
decision_rule.if_material_contract_or_package_identity: advance to 0.1.0a2 / v0.1.0-alpha.2 or another explicitly reviewed pre-release identity
decision_rule.if_public_contract_and_package_identity_: 0.1.0a1 / v0.1.0-alpha.1 may be retained because no release was published

repository_restart_model: clean-slate implementation preserving proven semantic contracts only

candidate_identity_layers.container_layer: external preflight receipt created after upload binds Actions artifact ID/digest to payload-manifest digest
candidate_identity_layers.payload_layer: payload manifest binds member bytes + source/release/run identities before upload
candidate_identity_layers.reason: container digest cannot be self-embedded in the container it hashes

source_binding.required_exact_commit: 40 lowercase hex supplied at dispatch and equality-checked against GITHUB_SHA
source_binding.required_repository_id: capture and freeze before implementation promotion
source_binding.required_tree: compute at preflight and embed in all receipts
